newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks end higher on blue chip trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks end higher on blue chip trade.

text.p: Sri Lankan stocks closed slightly higher on Tuesday spurred by the sale of a large block of shares of a blue chip finance firm, brokers said.
The Colombo Stock Exchange all share index closed 2.8 points up at 774.6.
The sale of some 221,000 shares of DFCC at 280 rupees, up two rupees, helped prop up turnover at almost 98 million rupees, down from Monday's 102.8 million rupees, he said.
"Local fund managers and high networth clients are buying but retailers are selling for profit-taking," said Shanil Perera of brokerage Lanka Securities.
